doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Back in the States with a successful band
summary: Back in the US his group of Newark players, including Cecil Payne and Dave Burns, had big success.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: So then you came back to the States -­
I came back in the States and -- and everything was, I mean, man, everywhere we went, boy, big success musically, you know.
And who was in your group at that time?

I had a fellow by the name of -- I had guys from Newark. I had Chink Williams [phonetic sp.] on drums, Larry Gowan [phonetic sp.] at the bass, [indiscernible] King [phonetic sp.] played piano with me.
Donald Cole [phonetic sp.] was a trombone player and Cecil Payne [phonetic sp.] was the baritone player, I think.

And Dave Burns was the trumpet player. You know. That -- that was the band. Nice little band, too, man. Good little band and we played and then I sent for my family; they came over. You know, they. And then I'd be on the road and different things happen, you know. Time went by. And then had a boy. So I had a little -- I had -- I had a little boy and then later on, we had a little girl, all right? And things, you know, things were going along okay, but I guess maybe she was lonely for France, too.
